correctness.rationale: Full Fourier diagonalization yields the two exact multipliers; their joint zero is equivalent to two cosine scalars satisfying one monic rational quadratic. Integral symmetric functions force integer gains. The rational-root case yields precisely 15 unordered scalar pairs; the irreducible case uses real-cyclotomic degree phi(q)/2=2, giving precisely q=5,8,10,12 with two conjugate scalar values and 2 frequencies per scalar per divisible period. This proves the exact nullity and rank for every m,n>=3, independently of finite checks. Exact symbolic and numerical finite tests passed.
